title: Independent External Validation of Frozen Recurrent Malignant Programs

signature_lock.missing_gene_rule: report and retain missing genes; never substitute or optimize genes
signature_lock.GSE196756_role: excluded from independent external validation and signature construction

GSE199654.primary_cells: author-provided epithelial cells from sampleType T only
GSE199654.qc: published epithelial re-QC thresholds reproducible from public counts: 200 <= detected genes < 6000 and mitochondrial UMI fraction < 5%; published DoubletScore <1 cannot be reproduced because per-cell DoubletScore is not public and is recorded as a limitation
GSE199654.malignant_definition: tumor-origin invasive-cancer epithelial cells; no normal/dysplasia/stage comparison

GSE203067.primary_cells: primary-tumor libraries ESCC_T1 through ESCC_T4 only; lymph-node and adjacent-normal cells excluded from primary validation
GSE203067.patient_id: patient number parsed from official barcode suffix map
GSE203067.sample_id: official barcode suffix map; technical T4 library suffixes are aggregated to patient 4
GSE203067.qc: published thresholds: UMI >=300, genes >=200, log10(genes)/log10(UMI)>0.8, mitochondrial UMI fraction <20%
GSE203067.epithelial_rule: after log1p(CP10K), epithelial panel mean must be the largest of four lineage-panel means; at least two epithelial-panel genes and at least one of EPCAM/SFN/TP63/KRT5/KRT14 must have nonzero UMI; PTPRC must have zero UMI
GSE203067.malignant_definition: primary-tumor-origin epithelial cells selected by the frozen rule; original publication independently confirmed primary/LN malignant epithelium by large-scale CNV

cell_score.method: single-sample rank score (singscore-like), computed from raw UMI ranks
cell_score.formula: within each cell rank all platform genes ascending with average ties; normalized mean rank of covered signature genes = (mean_rank-(m+1)/2)/(N-m), bounded to [0,1]
cell_score.missing_platform_genes: excluded from m only after explicit coverage reporting
cell_score.dropout: zero counts retain their tied low rank and are not imputed
cell_score.high_score_fraction: fraction above the cohort-wide malignant-cell 75th percentile for the same RMP and signature size

patient_pseudobulk: sum raw UMI within patient, CP10K normalization, log1p; no cell is treated as an independent biological replicate

detectability.matched_null: 1000 random gene sets of identical covered size, matching each frozen gene by malignant-cell detection-rate decile; sampling fixed by seed and independent of outcomes
detectability.patient_effect: z score of observed patient-pseudobulk rank score relative to its matched random-set distribution
detectability.DETECTED: coverage >=70%, median patient z >0, and >=70% evaluable patients have z>0
detectability.MIXED: coverage >=60% and either median patient z >0 or >=50% patients have z>0
detectability.NOT_DETECTED: coverage >=60% and neither DETECTED nor MIXED
detectability.formal_test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank of patient z against zero; BH FDR across seven RMPs within cohort and signature size; P/FDR are supplementary, not sole criteria

leave_one_patient_out.major_instability: any LOPO median-z sign reversal relative to full median, or maximum absolute LOPO change greater than max(1.0, patient-z IQR), or largest patient contributes >=80% of summed positive patient z

coherence.rank_structure: within each patient pseudobulk, Spearman correlation between covered signature-gene expression and negative frozen consensus rank
coherence.gene_gene: median pairwise Spearman correlation among nonconstant covered signature genes across patient pseudobulks
coherence.COHERENT: median rank-structure rho >=0.15, >50% patient rank-structure rho positive, and median gene-gene rho >0
coherence.MIXED: at least one of median rank-structure rho or median gene-gene rho is positive
coherence.small_n: coherence for cohorts with <5 patients is explicitly exploratory

signature_size_consistency.metric: Spearman correlation of Top50 versus Top100 patient median scores

distinctness.metrics: Spearman score correlation at malignant-cell and patient-median levels plus frozen Top50 Jaccard
distinctness.near_redundancy_review: cell and patient rho >=0.90 and Top50 Jaccard >=0.80; report only, never merge

cohort_level_interpretation.STRONG_EXTERNAL_SUPPORT: GOOD coverage, DETECTED, no major patient instability, COHERENT, and ROBUST_TO_SIGNATURE_SIZE
cohort_level_interpretation.MODERATE_EXTERNAL_SUPPORT: coverage >=70%, no major instability, and at least two of DETECTED, COHERENT, ROBUST_TO_SIGNATURE_SIZE
cohort_level_interpretation.LIMITED_MIXED_SUPPORT: evaluable but does not meet stronger rules

overall_interpretation: combine all preselected cohorts without dropping weak cohorts: STRONG requires both cohorts at least MODERATE and one STRONG; MODERATE requires both at least LIMITED and one at least MODERATE; NOT_SUPPORTED requires all evaluable cohorts NOT_SUPPORTED; otherwise LIMITED_MIXED; exploratory RMPs cannot be upgraded
multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within each formal hypothesis family
